_comment: Copy to site.config.json (gitignored) and fill in real secrets. These are the shared settings applied to every OTD500; the site name + label password are typed into the UI per device (one device at a time).
_comment_internet: FOTA, Tailscale and eSIM need the SIM to have a data connection, which can take a minute+ to attach on a fresh SIM. wait_for_internet makes the tool poll the modem until it's online (up to internet_timeout seconds) before those steps. Local-.bin firmware and RMS-enable do NOT need internet.

firmware._comment: mode = local (upload a pinned .bin from this machine), fota (device pulls latest-stable from Teltonika), rms (defer — registered device upgrades itself on first RMS connect), or none.

rms._comment_auth_code: Optional per-company RMS authentication code. Leave blank to register each device by serial+MAC at run time (set api_token + company_id below) — then they connect without a code.
rms._comment_api: api_token must be an RMS Personal Access Token with the 'devices:read' + 'devices:write' scopes, and the account must have 2FA enabled (else the API returns 403). The bench run auto-registers each device by serial+MAC; password_confirmation uses new_password above. device_series is the RMS device family ('otd' for OTD500).
rms._comment_pack: Optional license: assign a Management pack right after registration (the RMS UI's Actions -> Device -> 'Set pack'). Accepts the RMS pack type name ('management_3y' = Paid Management pack 3y.), a numeric credit_type_id, or a fragment of the display name. Leave empty to keep credit-based management. Needs the 'credits:read' + 'device_credits:write' scopes on api_token (on top of devices:read/write above). NOTE: packs cannot be revoked once assigned; the step skips devices that already carry a matching pack.

tailscale._comment_key: Either paste a single reusable auth_key, OR set mint_per_device + an api_key/tailnet to mint a fresh ephemeral, pre-authorized key per device via the Tailscale API (recommended).

esim._comment: eSIM provisioning needs a per-device activation code, which the single-device UI does not collect, so keep enabled=false.
